patterns.ipc_handler_pattern: Use ipcMain.handle() with async handlers, access app context for shared resources
patterns.api_interface_pattern: Add methods to CostApi interface in core/types/api.ts, implement in desktop handlers
patterns.type_pattern: Use branded types (e.g., type ModelName = Brand<string, 'ModelName'>) and discriminated unions for state
patterns.component_pattern: React components in ui/src/components/, views in ui/src/views/, hooks in ui/src/hooks/
patterns.test_pattern: Vitest tests in __tests__ directories, use descriptive test names
patterns.error_handling: Never use any, @ts-ignore, or non-null assertions; handle errors with discriminated unions

existing_implementations.description: Found existing IPC handler patterns, UI preferences system, and MCP server integration
existing_implementations.preferences_pattern: Preferences stored as JSON files, accessed via getXPreferences/saveXPreferences methods in CostApi
existing_implementations.mcp_pattern: MCP server tools in packages/mcp/src/tools/, registered in tools/index.ts

key_decisions.ollama_integration: Use Ollama HTTP API (http://localhost:11434) for model management and inference
key_decisions.privacy_first: All inference runs locally, no network calls except to localhost Ollama
key_decisions.opt_in: AI features disabled by default, require user to install Ollama and download a model
key_decisions.performance: Target < 5 seconds for insight generation on mid-range hardware
key_decisions.mcp_integration: Extend existing MCP server to channel AI queries for external assistants
